title: On-demand Compliance Docket Generator and Geo-aware Dispatch API
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an on-demand Compliance Docket Generator and a lightweight Geo-aware Dispatch API so customers can request, schedule, and receive tenant-scoped compliance dockets (PDF + CSV) that respect data residency and retention policies. The docket is a verified, signed package containing evidence slices (request logs, policy snapshots, sample outputs) plus an auditable manifest. This feature complements existing scheduled exports by providing: ad-hoc generation, per-tenant residency override checks, short-lived download tokens, and an API-first dispatch mechanism for integration with customer SIEMs and archival systems.
acceptance_criteria: API endpoint POST /v1/tenants/:tenant_id/dockets that accepts a docket_request payload (time range, evidence types, output format preferences) and returns a docket_job_id

Docket generator compiles CSV export of events and a PDF summary report with configurable templates (legal + engineering templates) and includes a machine-readable manifest listing included files and SHA256 hashes

Geo residency enforcement: generation engine validates resident data locations against tenant residency policy; if any records violate residency, those records are redacted and listed in the manifest with redaction reasons
Signed package: generated ZIP is signed server-side using KMS-managed signing key; customers can opt-in to have package signed with tenant-specific key (KMS/HSM) if configured
Dispatch modes: immediate download URL (short-lived S3-presigned), scheduled delivery via webhook to an endpoint, or push to configured cloud storage (S3/GCS) with region-aware routing
Retention-aware selection: tickets older than retention windows are excluded and noted; operators can request a 'retention-proof' section that shows retention policy evaluation for chosen evidence
Audit trail: each docket_job produces an audit record (job metadata, policy checks, signer fingerprint, delivery method) viewable in Console under Compliance > Dockets
Rate limiting and quota: Docket generation respects tenant export quotas and leaves token-level cost visibility in billing reports
End-to-end test: sample tenant with multi-region data yields a docket package that passes automated verification (manifest integrity, signature verification, residency compliance checks)
notes: Scope decision: this ticket focuses on the generator + dispatch API and Console listing; long-term orchestration for bulk daily shipments remains a follow-up (see PM-61235)

Trade-offs: we will implement server-side PDF rendering (wkhtmltopdf variant) to support templated legal summaries; avoids depending on customer-side tooling but increases runtime memory use on job workers
Security: contact secops for an abbreviated threat model. Signed packages must be verifiable with tenant public keys; support HSM-backed signing for enterprise customers
Performance: docket generation is expensive for large time ranges. We'll surface preflight cost estimate and suggest pre-sampled 'evidence snapshots' for large exports
Telemetry: add docket_job.duration_ms and docket_job.size_bytes metrics and create alert for median > 30s for small jobs
UX: provide a compact Console flow: Request > Preview (cost + affected regions) > Confirm > Delivery. Include a canned legal template that customers can fork
Links: design spec - https://drive.redwood.ai/designs/docket-generator, api contract draft - https://github.com/redwood-inference/api-proposals/pull/28
